materials: Original code-generated stone joints, dense irregular fine pebble basecolor/normal/roughness, soil and hedge leaves. Pebble surface supersedes initial oversized stone geometry. Photo-supported category and relative scale, not a scan.

treeLibrary.reused: Only original generic geometry/materials. No other site coordinates or geometry copied.

estimates: tree species unknown; representative broadleaf library, no field identification
height, crown radius, stem points, hedge dimensions, soil and paving pattern estimated
flat forecourt datum follows existing approach paving top -1.65m; not measured elevation
roof width, building high levels and existing stair rises remain the original model estimates

17 small irregular root-soil patches, four soil beds inside the existing hedge enclosures, and narrow ground-colored supporting banks are display estimates; only outer seam height/color/normal follows the actual website context mesh.
gaps: No reliable contiguous interior plan or geolocated camera route
No surveyed individual trees or ground classification beyond conservative visible canopy
Paifang reliefs, lettering, gate painting, stone lions and monumental inscriptions not reconstructed
reproduce: With exclusive GPU token: blender --background --threads 4 --python scripts/render_ground_v2.py -- --color-only
scope: Only the entry forecourt outside the round gate; original building study retained. No interior route.
groundDisplayBoundsStatus: The old continuous planting-support plane has been removed; no rectangular soil classification remains.
vegetationNote: 17 representative canopy samples, four estimated clipped hedge enclosures and representative short grass in their beds. Exact species and horticultural arrangement are not surveyed.
publicIntegration: Independent candidate only; root owns formal model/catalog changes and browser QA. Keep current placement/scale/geography and vegetationSrc null.
pebbleCorrection: Dense irregular warm-grey/brown fine pebbles via original PBR at representative 0.9m repeat / 35 grains; exact physical size is estimated. Supersedes oversized regular six-sided stone geometry.

groundRevision.reason: Remove unsupported 62x34m continuous dark soil plane; keep dark soil only below existing trees and inside four photo-supported hedge beds.
groundRevision.actualEvidence: Existing photograph/imagery categories retained unchanged; existing model trees and buildings retained byte-equivalent in geometry.
groundRevision.estimated: All tree pit outlines, transition widths and local path support banks are visual estimates, not a surveyed ground reconstruction.
groundRevision.seamBasis: Execute transpiled createSiteContext unchanged, then inverse-transform its Float32 triangle mesh into model local coordinates. Colors are linear RGB; normals are the actual computed vertex normals.
groundRevision.gpuPreviewStatus: Two corresponding color-corrected images rendered and inspected; six pre-color spatial comparison images retained with 05dd predecessor.
groundRevision.websiteIntegrationStatus: Pending root final website wide/approach/low-side QA; no public model or code files written by D.

colorSampling.scope: Only new soil-to-context ring interior colors; outer context colors, all geometry and accepted materials untouched

groundRevision.preColorIndependentReview: ../F-review/ZHENGYI_GROUND_V2_REVIEW.md accepts 05dd predecessor spatial grounding; color-only delta proven by attribute comparison.
